en-US.description: AI file renamer and batch rename tool for Windows. Bulk rename PDFs, screenshots, photos, videos, audio, and Office documents by what they contain.
en-US.longDescription:
Zush is an AI file renamer and batch rename tool for Windows that renames files by what they
contain, not just by the old filename or metadata. Drop in PDFs, scans, screenshots, images, RAW
photos, videos, audio files, Office documents, spreadsheets, presentations, subtitles, a whole
Downloads folder, or a mixed archive, then review clear AI-generated names before anything is
applied.

Use Zush as a PDF renamer for invoices and scanned documents, an image or photo renamer for
screenshots and camera imports, a document renamer for Office files, or a file organizer for
messy folders. Zush turns names like "IMG_2842.png", "Scan_001.pdf" or "Document (3).docx" into
descriptive, searchable filenames.

Features:
- Rename files by actual content with AI
- Batch rename and bulk rename large folders
- Rename PDFs, scans, receipts, invoices and documents
- Rename images, screenshots, RAW photos, videos and audio files
- Organize Downloads folders and mixed archive folders
- Review and edit AI rename suggestions before changing files
- Undo rename operations when needed
- Build repeatable naming workflows with Smart Rename templates
- Use Naming Blocks for dates, document fields, metadata, tags and custom text
- Monitor folders and automatically rename new files in the background
- Write custom AI instructions for structured file naming
- Output filenames in many languages or match the file content language

Zush supports Cloud AI, BYOK with your own provider key, and Offline AI with local Ollama models
for private workflows. Zush is free to install and includes a free AI rename allowance; PRO
unlocks unlimited AI renames, advanced templates, Naming Blocks, custom prompts, BYOK and
Offline AI.

This package is the portable build. It is self-contained and needs no separate .NET runtime.
en-US.name: Zush
